## Features

AVENIQ custom software development packages deliver powerful business engineering capabilities:

- **Tailored Customer Relationship Management (CRM)**: Bespoke pipeline management, client record tracking, contact history, and automated communication triggers.
- **Custom Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)**: Modular business management tools controlling inventory, procurement, resource allocation, and internal asset tracking.
- **Role-Based Security & Fine-Grained Permissions**: Strict user access controls ensuring staff only view and edit data pertinent to their job function.
- **Automated Document & Report Generation**: One-click creation of PDF invoices, service agreements, operational audit reports, and exportable data spreadsheets.
- **Centralized Operational Dashboards**: Real-time visual monitoring displays customized for executives, operational managers, and field staff.
- **Interactive Multi-Step Workflows**: Automated task routing that passes approvals, tasks, and notifications across departments seamlessly.
- **Audit Trails & Change Logging**: Comprehensive data logging tracking every modification, record access, and system update for accountability.
